description: Multidisciplinary team powered by Tech Evo, bringing together AI, data science, software development, design, Earth observation and creative problem-solving. We aim to turn NASA data into impactful, usable solutions—not just prototypes. Looking for motivated teammates skilled in AI/ML, data, GIS, web/mobile development, UI/UX, research, visualization and storytelling. Curiosity, collaboration and execution matter most.
summary:
TerraWise is a smart agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers adapt to changing environmental and climate conditions using NASA data. The platform provides location-based environmental insights, including temperature, rainfall, and humidity, to support more informed agricultural decisions.

It features a Crop Rotation Lab that allows farmers to compare different crop rotation strategies, a LandMatch system that connects farmers with available agricultural land, and a voice assistant that makes agricultural information more accessible.

By combining NASA Earth observation data with practical digital tools, TerraWise aims to promote sustainable farming, improve water management, protect soil health, and strengthen agricultural resilience to climate change.
details:
TerraWise is a web-based smart agriculture platform developed to support farmers in making sustainable and climate-aware farming decisions.

The platform combines NASA POWER environmental data with practical agricultural tools. NASA POWER API is used to retrieve environmental data based on geographical coordinates.

Our solution is creative because it brings satellite-based environmental information and practical farming services together in one accessible platform. It combines climate awareness, sustainable agriculture, digital land matching, and user-friendly interaction.

Our main goal is to help farmers make better-informed decisions, encourage responsible water use, improve soil management, and strengthen agricultural resilience to climate change.

The platform was designed with accessibility, simplicity, location-based information, and the practical needs of farmers in mind.
